note: Photo records for /why-chapter-3/ (second rewrite, 2026-11-12). The Garden City Beach record is copied from data/2026-11-b/invest-strategies/photos.json (itself from /invest/condos/): a public domain USGS oblique aerial, 2011. It is the fallback of the Garden City Beach homes strip and shows only until the strip has homes. The first rewrite used the Government and Justice Center photo; that page section is cut.

photos.title: Condo towers and low-rise condo buildings on North Waccamaw Drive, Garden City Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A stretch of oceanfront at Garden City Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: low-rise condo buildings with pools on the left, a tall tan tower in the middle, a white five-story building with a pool and the edge of another tower on the right. Streets of beach houses run back from the shore road to a wide salt marsh, with more houses on the far side of the marsh. Beach umbrellas line the sand; people are too small to recognize.
photos.caption: Garden City Beach, outside city limits: a condo tower and low-rise condo buildings on North Waccamaw Drive, with the marsh behind, seen from a plane in 2011.
photos.alt: A tall tan condo tower and several low-rise condo buildings with pools on the beach at Garden City, with beach houses and a wide salt marsh behind them

place.sublocation: North Waccamaw Drive, Garden City Beach, unincorporated Horry County (tax district 610)
